ReadMe.Statement: DRAFT v0.1 — companion registry authored 2026-09-05 from the RATIFIED Lenses section of the AIVIA Design Document (protocol step 2). The doc is the authority; any doc change updates this registry in the same breath. All build deferred by the phase ruling.
A lens is deterministic — same inputs, same graph state, same answer, replayable [M5]. If it needs a model it is not a lens (that is MATCHING — inward flow).
Every lens declares: name+version · reads (closed) · yields (declared shape) · completeness · writes NOTHING ever.
The union of all reads columns, held against all layer 2-3 node classes, IS the reachability accounting: every class read by some lens or carrying a recorded exclusion. Built as CHECK-LENS-D1.

Builders_and_Readings.Definition: twin-graph ruling (2026-09-06) 3: the lens STRATUM retires into two contracts; this sheet + Reclassification are the authority over the Catalog_v1 rows where they differ. Doc is authority.

loader -> KG1 · parser -> KG2a · TRANSLATOR -> KG2b (the 'translation lens' renamed to what it is). Deterministic; versioned, stamps every node written; writes ONLY its own layer; total with counted gaps; version bump rebuilds everything it governs. Governance has NO builder.
named, versioned, deterministic, writes nothing; kept for citability (dispositions and concept bases quote reading output by version); most are versioned queries
a reading exists iff its yield is ABOUT the graph for one consumer — status, aggregation, comparison — never meaning itself; the translator absorbed everything secretly computing meaning

Ask_Console.Definition: ADR 0078 (2026-09-06): the ask-the-graph console — free questions, TYPED paths (Group E: the path space is data, enumerable, replayable), self-answering nodes (ADR 0077: translation total -> no answer shapes). NOT the deferred inward flow: no data-question matching, no generation, no open chat (tier lock). The op set below is CLOSED: adding an op is a ruling, never a code default.
the entity's card — steward words / floor text, kind, identity, anchors
what reads it, what it reads — traversal over resolves_to + draws_from
every condition citing the column, voiced by the grammar
scopes + files reading the entity (usage events join when present)
terms and their definitions; concepts via their accepted terms
the taxonomy census for the entity or the estate — drift findable by name
